title: Project: a mug

initial.text: All of Level 2 in one object: a cylinder hollowed with Inset and Extrude, a handle from two extruded faces bridged together, and a beveled rim.

steps.text: Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Cylinder.
Vertices 16: smooth enough for a round mug.
Radius 0.8 m.
Edit Mode.
Face select mode.
Click the top face.
Face ▸ Inset Faces for the rim.
Thickness 0.08 m: the wall of the mug.
Face ▸ Extrude Faces, inward.
Move Z −1.8 m: deep, leaving a 20 cm bottom.
Edge select mode, for the loop cut.
Edge ▸ Loop Cut and Slide: the handle needs more rings.
Click a side edge on the outside.
Number of Cuts 3: four bands up the side.
Back to Face select.
Click the top band on the right side.
Shift-click the bottom band below it.
Extrude both faces outward.
Move Z 0.5 m: two stubs.
Edge ▸ Bridge Edge Loops joins the two stubs with a bar: the handle.
Edge select mode again.
Click an edge of the outer rim.
Select ▸ Select Loops ▸ Edge Loops: the whole rim.
Edge ▸ Bevel Edges to soften the rim.
Width 0.04 m.
Segments 3: a rounded lip.

outro: A mug with a handle, from one cylinder. That is Level 2.
